record: Experiment 4C — deterministic mapping of the historical C2 execution ledger to the normalized formal event schema
style_precedent: follows the committed experiment4-c1 adapter conventions (.creator-zero/formal/adapters.py, .creator-zero/tests/formal/fixtures/experiment4-c1-adapter-mapping.json): model_invocation_start -> consult, model_invocation_end -> propose by the invoked role, phase transitions -> tau, node completion -> the node primitive's execution label with actor node:<id>

mapping_full_granularity.label: observe
mapping_full_granularity.rationale: session start acquires task + contract as governed evidence

mapping_full_granularity.label: consult
mapping_full_granularity.rationale: information-only interaction opened by the creator (adapter precedent)

mapping_full_granularity.label: propose
mapping_full_granularity.rationale: the invoked role returns a typed proposal (adapter precedent)

mapping_full_granularity.label: tau
mapping_full_granularity.rationale: internal phase bookkeeping; no governed authority action

mapping_full_granularity.label: tau
mapping_full_granularity.rationale: node execution is recorded at node_end (adapter precedent: start markers are silent)

mapping_full_granularity.label: observe
mapping_full_granularity.rationale: test primitive maps to the observe execution label (labels.py PRIMITIVE_LABEL)

mapping_full_granularity.label: tau
mapping_full_granularity.rationale: recorded internal anomaly and its resolution; no authority-bearing transition; preserved verbatim in the immutable raw ledger

mapping_full_granularity.label: return + complete (two normalized events)
mapping_full_granularity.rationale: the raw line conflates completion of the compile-result return node (deliverables_verified lists its outputs) with session completion; deterministically split 1->2, in that order. Nothing is dropped and nothing else is added.

role_abstraction_view.purpose: H6 compares the C2 ROLE interface, not intra-session epistemic machinery. This view quotients actor identity and hides intra-session machinery as tau.
role_abstraction_view.actor_relabeling: every actor -> 'c2-role' (session-internal node/role naming is implementation identity, not role behavior; precedent: Experiment 4 session-equivalence treated persist/exit/reconstruct as hidden and compared governed behavior, separating process identity from behavioral equivalence)

tau_hidden_event_classes.class: consult/propose pairs of intra-session model sub-invocations (historical decomposer/composer synthesis)
tau_hidden_event_classes.justification: sub-invocations inside C2's own budget are epistemic machinery internal to the role; the parent boundary observes only their externalized products
non-authority bookkeeping; precedent: persist hidden as tau in the committed e4-c1 session-equivalence mapping

role_abstraction_view.NOT_hidden: witness-authoring propose events, node execution observe/verify events, return, complete — these are the role's governed interface. In particular C2-prime's propose (witness authoring) is deliberately kept observable even though hiding it would force a bisimulation PASS: it is the capability under test.
role_abstraction_view.known_asymmetry: the historical ledger contains no observable witness-authoring propose event (historical C2 authored its K3 attestation inside its compile-result return node); this asymmetry is expected to be the distinguishing action if role-level bisimulation fails
